title: Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release
text:
This Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release ("Agreement") is made and entered into this 15th day of January, 2024, by and between Maria Elena Vasquez ("Plaintiff") and Lone Star Logistics, Inc., a Texas corporation d/b/a Fast Freight Solutions ("Defendant"). The parties agree to settle the claims arising from the personal injury incident that occurred on March 3, 2023, in Harris County, Texas, as more fully described in Cause No. 2023-CV-04567, pending in the 234th Judicial District Court of Harris County, Texas.

WHEREAS, Plaintiff Maria Elena Vasquez, born on May 22, 1985, alleges that she sustained serious bodily injuries when a commercial vehicle operated by an employee of Lone Star Logistics, Inc., d/b/a Fast Freight Solutions, collided with her vehicle at the intersection of Westheimer Road and Fondren Road;

WHEREAS, Defendant denies any liability but wishes to avoid the time, expense, and uncertainty of litigation;

WHEREAS, the parties have negotiated a settlement and wish to memorialize their agreement;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises and covenants contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

1. Settlement Amount. Defendant agrees to pay Plaintiff the sum of Four Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($450,000.00), less attorney's fees and costs, to be paid within thirty (30) days of full execution of this Agreement. Payment shall be made by wire transfer to the trust account of Plaintiff's counsel, Thompson & Associates, PLLC, whose counsel is Sarah J. Thompson, Esq.

2. Release. Plaintiff, on behalf of herself and her heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns, hereby fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant Lone Star Logistics, Inc., d/b/a Fast Freight Solutions, its officers, directors, employees, agents, and affiliates, from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, or liabilities arising out of the incident described above.

3. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement shall remain confidential and shall not be disclosed to any third party except as required by law or to the parties' respective legal and financial advisors.

4. No Admission of Liability. This Agreement is a compromise and settlement of disputed claims and shall not be construed as an admission of liability by Defendant.

5. Indemnification. Plaintiff agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Defendant from any and all claims by third parties arising out of the incident, including any subrogation claims by Plaintiff's health insurance provider, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas.

6. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first above written.

Maria Elena Vasquez (Plaintiff)

By: ___________________________
Maria Elena Vasquez

Lone Star Logistics, Inc., d/b/a Fast Freight Solutions (Defendant)

By: ___________________________
Robert D. Martinez, Vice President

Approved as to form and content:

Sarah J. Thompson, Esq.
Thompson & Associates, PLLC
Attorney for Plaintiff

David M. Chen, Esq.
Chen & Partners, LLP
Attorney for Defendant

The parties also acknowledge the prior involvement of Judge Patricia A. Williams, who presided over the pre-trial conferences. Additionally, the Court of Appeals for the First District of Texas issued a ruling in a related case, Vasquez v. Lone Star Logistics, Inc., 678 S.W.3d 123 (Tex. App.—Houston [1st Dist.] 2023), which influenced the settlement. The court also cited the case Martinez v. Fast Freight, 456 S.W.3d 789 (Tex. App.—Houston [14th Dist.] 2022). The relevant statute is Tex. Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code § 41.008.

Plaintiff's Social Security Number is 458-23-9876. Her phone number is (713) 555-0198 and her email address is maria.vasquez@email.com. Her date of birth, as previously stated, is May 22, 1985. The Defendant's corporate headquarters are located at 1200 Commerce Street, Houston, Texas 77002.
